name: Table
summary: A data grid — results, leaderboard, participant/admin list — rendered through the shared DataTable.
lead: Too complex to rebuild as a web component, so Table stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both rendered through the shared DataTable and themed once by components.Table. Two implementations, one DS V3 look, policed by visual regression. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Container
spec.value: white surface, 1px #E3E3E3 border, radius 8 — wraps the whole grid

spec.label: Body
spec.value: horizontal dividers #E3E3E3 only, no zebra; row 60px

spec.label: Customisations (DS V3)
spec.value: sorting (single arrow) · filtering (checklist/range) · reorder · resize · rows-per-page · freeze · add/remove columns

props.name: columns
props.desc: dataIndex / key / title / sorter / filter / fixed / width

props.name: freezable
props.desc: right-click header to freeze one column

whenToUse.when: any rows×columns grid — results, leaderboard, admin list
a bare antd Table restyled per call site is the drift this replaces

opinion.note: White header (not antd grey #fafafa), single-arrow sort (not dual caret), Phosphor icons, tokenised colour. The look is theme-driven; call sites pass data + columns only.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared tableTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme + the same DataTable wrapper; residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite = two vendors, so BOTH framework roots must hit the contract AND match each other (parity).
conformance.measure: root => { var g=function(sel,p){var el=document.querySelector(root+' '+sel);return el?getComputedStyle(el)[p]:null;}; var td='.ant-table-tbody .ant-table-cell'; return { headerBg:g('.ant-table-thead th','backgroundColor'), headerColor:g('.ant-table-thead th','color'), tdPadTop:g(td,'paddingTop'), tdPadLeft:g(td,'paddingLeft'), tdBorder:g(td,'borderBottomColor'), tdBorderW:g(td,'borderBottomWidth'), containerBorderW:g('.ant-table','borderTopWidth'), containerBorder:g('.ant-table','borderTopColor'), containerRadius:g('.ant-table','borderTopLeftRadius') }; }
